# itch.io listings — copy and paste

> **Every listing needs a cover image.** They are rendered and ready in
> `dist/itch/covers/` — one PNG per game, 630×500, which is itch's recommended
> ratio. Upload the one matching the game as its **Cover image**.
>
> This is not decoration. On an itch browse page the cover is very nearly the
> whole pitch, and a listing with itch's default placeholder is a game nobody
> clicks.

Six ZIPs in this folder, all verified to run standalone with no ad tag, no
analytics and a link back to xoxoxo.live.

## For every upload

- **Kind of project:** HTML
- Tick **"This file will be played in the browser"**
- **Viewport:** 400 × 700 · tick **"Mobile friendly"** and **"Automatically start on page load"**
- **Pricing:** No payments
- **Classification:** Game · **Release status:** Released
- **Genre:** Puzzle (Snake: Action)
- **Tags:** `browser`, `no-download`, `mobile`, `casual`, `free`, plus the per-game tags below
- **Links → More information:** `https://xoxoxo.live`

---

## 1. Sudoku — `sudoku.zip` + cover `covers/sudoku.png`

**Title:** Sudoku — always solvable by logic

**Short description**
```
One to nine, once each. Three difficulties, every puzzle solvable without guessing.
```

**Description**
```
Fill every row, column and box with one to nine.

Every puzzle is generated with exactly one solution, which means you never
have to guess — if you are stuck, there is always something to deduce. Three
difficulties, and tapping a number highlights every other one so you can see
the board rather than scan it.

There is also a Daily Sudoku at xoxoxo.live/daily — the same puzzle for
everyone, every day, with a result you can share.

No sign-up, no download. Works on any phone.

More free games at https://xoxoxo.live
```
**Extra tags:** `sudoku`, `logic`, `numbers`, `daily`

---
## 2. 2048 — `2048.zip` + cover `covers/2048.png`

**Title:** 2048 — join the tiles

**Short description**
```
Join matching tiles until you reach 2048. One more go, every time.
```

**Description**
```
Swipe to slide every tile. Matching tiles merge and double.

Two things make it kinder than most versions: one level of undo, because a
misswipe should not end a good run, and reaching 2048 does not stop the game
— it asks if you would like to keep going.

Swipe or use the arrow keys.

No sign-up, no download. Works on any phone.

More free games at https://xoxoxo.live
```
**Extra tags:** `2048`, `merge`, `numbers`, `high-score`

---
## 3. Snake — `snake.zip` + cover `covers/snake.png`

**Title:** Snake — levels, streaks and one more go

**Short description**
```
Eat, grow, don't bite yourself. Every level is worth more than the last.
```

**Description**
```
Snake, with a reason to go deeper.

Every few apples you level up: the game speeds up and each apple is worth
more. An apple at level 7 is worth seven times one at level 1 — so one long
run beats twenty short ones, and the pull is always to get further.

Swipe or use the arrow keys. Three starting speeds. Your best level is
remembered.

No sign-up, no download. Works on any phone.

More free games at https://xoxoxo.live
```
**Extra tags:** `snake`, `arcade`, `high-score`, `endless`

## 4. Memory — `memory.zip` + cover `covers/memory.png`

**Title:** Memory — find every pair

## 5. Tic-Tac-Toe — `tic-tac-toe.zip` + cover `covers/tic-tac-toe.png`

**Title:** Tic-Tac-Toe — pass and play, or beat the computer

**Short description (≤ 120 chars)**
```
Three in a row. Play a friend on one phone, or a computer that never loses.

**Description**
```
The classic, done properly.

Play a friend on the same phone, or take on the computer at three levels.
The hardest one is called Perfect because that is what it is — it plays
flawlessly, so a draw is the best result available. See if you can get one.

No sign-up, no download, no timers. Works on any phone.

More free games at https://xoxoxo.live

## Order

The numbering above is the order to create them.
Sudoku and 2048 carry the largest standing search demand on itch, and
Sudoku is the one that links to the Daily — so the strongest pages exist
even if you stop early.
